g.text: Restaurant Rush - Class Diagram (final design: Stage 3 + optional window view marked «extra»)
: all fields private; state only changes through
seatAt / placeOrder / serve / pay / leave, which check the current
CustomerState first. Satisfaction is clamped to 0..100 inside the class.
reactToService() on a Customer reference - no type checks.
built from two MenuItems (units = sum, price = 90%), so Order,
Chef and PriceCalculator handle it with no changes.
in perform(); a failed task does not use the turn.
after tag stage-3) plugs in with no rule changes.
